The Empire Collapses: News from Petrograd: the Tsar has abdicated and a Provisional Government holds the reins, while soviets spring up in every garrison. In Reval the streets are full of soldiers and workers debating the fate of the empire - and of the Baltic provinces within it.
The republic must be born of this chaos.
Wait and watch the storm pass.
The Manifesto to All Peoples of Estonia

On 24 February 1918 the Committee of Elders reads the Manifesto to All Peoples of Estonia from the balcony of the Estonia Theatre: the Estonian people demand the right to self-determination. The blue, black and white flag is raised over Tallinn.
Let the world hear it!
A symbolic gesture, nothing more.
The War of Independence

The Red Army marches west through Narva, and the Baltische Landeswehr of Baltic German volunteers and White Russians musters in the south. The young republic must fight on two fronts at once - for its very existence.
Every rifle will be needed.
We cannot win this war.
The Baltische Landeswehr

The White Army of the Baltische Landeswehr - Baltic German barons, Russian officers and adventurers - advances on Riga and eyes the Estonian border. They promise to restore order and the old estates, while the republic promises land to the peasants.
Stand firm against them.
Seek accommodation with the Whites.
Victory in the War of Independence

The guns have fallen silent. After two years of fighting - against the Red Army, the Landeswehr and the Bermondians - the republic stands. The victors parade through Tallinn, and the farmer-soldiers dream of the land they will now receive.
For the independence we have won!
The Great Depression

The crash on Wall Street reaches the Baltic: grain prices collapse, factories close, and the banks of Tallinn tremble. The young republic's export economy is stricken, and unemployment marches through the towns of Ida-Viru and the manor districts alike.
We will weather this storm together.
Borrow and spend our way out.
The Vaps Movement

In the crisis of the early 1930s, the League of Veterans of the War of Independence - the Vaps - demands a strong presidency and an end to parliamentary squabbling. Their rallies fill the streets, and the government fears a coup from the right.
Let the veterans be heard.
Suppress the movement.
The Molotov-Ribbentrop Pact

The world holds its breath: the German and Soviet foreign ministers have signed a pact with secret protocols carving Eastern Europe into spheres of influence. The Baltic states are named in the Soviet sphere. Diplomats in Tallinn burn their cables and wonder what morning will bring.
Protest to the great powers.
There is nothing we can do.
The June Deportations

In the night of 14 June 1941, NKVD convoys carry away more than ten thousand Estonians - teachers, farmers, priests, officers - to the camps of Siberia. Whole families vanish before dawn, and the cattle low in stalls that will never be opened again.
Remember them.
The Forest Brothers

In the forests of southern Estonia, armed men slip out of the woods at night: the Forest Brothers. They strike at occupation garrisons and supply columns, then melt back into the pines. The occupiers call them bandits, and the people call them the hope of the nation.
Support the resistance.
Stay out of it.
The Singing Revolution

Hundreds of thousands gather in the Song Festival Grounds of Tallinn, singing the forbidden national songs until their voices shake the stands. Across the republic the same chorus rises in town squares - a revolution sung, not fought.
Sing until they cannot ignore us.
Keep a low profile.
Independence Restored

The Soviet Union is dissolving and the last tanks have left the streets. On 20 August 1991 the Supreme Council restores the independence of the Republic of Estonia. The blue, black and white flag rises over Toompea, and the world recognizes the reborn republic.
Long live the restored republic!
Declare Independence

The Russian Empire is in chaos and its armies are falling apart. Now is the moment to declare the independence of Estonia and let the world take note - while the guns of the great war still drown out lesser voices.
Defend the Republic
The young republic is at war on every front - the Red Army in the east, the Baltische Landeswehr in the south. Pour resources into the army and hold the line until victory.
Invite the Finnish Volunteers

Across the Gulf of Finland, Finnish volunteers - the sons of the kindred people - are ready to cross and fight for Estonia's freedom. Their rifles and their courage could turn the tide of the War of Independence.
Settle the Independence Veterans
The war is won and the Treaty of Tartu signed. Now the state must keep its promise: grant land to the veterans of the War of Independence, and bind the nation together with the farms of its own sons.
Confront the Vaps Movement

The veterans' league grows bold in the crisis years, marching through the capital and demanding a strong hand at the helm. The government must decide: face them down, or let the republic drift toward authoritarian rule.
Restore Constitutional Order
The crisis has passed and the emergency powers can be laid down. Restore the democratic constitution, reconcile the divided nation, and show Europe that the republic endures.
Respond to the Molotov-Ribbentrop Pact
The pact has carved the Baltics into a foreign sphere. Protest to the great powers, rally the people, and prepare the nation for the dark days that the diplomats in Berlin and Moscow have decreed.
Arm the Forest Brothers

Our land is occupied, but the forests are ours. Fund and arm the guerrillas who strike at the occupiers from the woods - the Forest Brothers - and keep the flame of resistance burning in the darkest hour.
Organize the Singing Revolution

The empire is weakening and the people are restless. Organize the mass song demonstrations that will carry the demand for independence into every square of the republic - a revolution sung with hundreds of thousands of voices.
Restore Independence
The Soviet Union is collapsing and the last occupying forces are leaving. Restore the independence of the Republic of Estonia and take the reborn nation's seat among the free peoples of the world.
Join NATO and the European Union

With independence secured, anchor the young republic in the West: seek membership of NATO and the European Union, binding Estonia's security and prosperity to the community of Western democracies for a generation and beyond.
Embrace the Digital Age

The internet has come to Tallinn. Invest in the digital infrastructure of e-Estonia - online government, digital identity, the Skype-born tech industry - and make the small republic the most wired nation on earth.
